approach.method_basis: The Parent evolves a score-selected population of molecular graphs and generates a fresh field of 160 valid, unseen molecules. An accepted-observation Gaussian process with count fingerprints supplies raw score means and a joint latent covariance. After three stalled announcements, the original mean ranking limits eligibility to forty candidates. The allocator samples 10,000 correlated function rows over the unchanged eligible field, counts each candidate's winner events, and buys the announced batch with the largest counts, resolving ties by original mean and pool order. Real accepted feedback updates the archive and score-greedy breeding population.
approach.novelty: Remove cross-candidate dependence only from the residuals used by that winner-count allocator, keeping every marginal variance and the original normal draws. This isolates whether qPO benefits from dependence between candidates when converting winner probability into paid progress. The frozen sibling controls address the winner-count objective and eligibility screen separately; the earlier correlation control acted only within restricted Thompson allocations. This control covers every successful qPO allocation and introduces no new acquisition objective.

observed_bottleneck: Actual code Parent n-0eae06e8d311 faithfully ran fixed-domain qPO in all 435 allocations, but complete Search macro mean 0.5580387031939377 trails formal Anchor n-cf8d309c06de by 0.04899161301719335, with every paired seed macro negative. The additive Analyze/Molecular v2 audits give 300 versus 253 incumbent updates yet only 5.243198882274432 versus 5.978073077532332 total increment mass on all 4350 paid observations; late mass is higher, 1.335237861278773 versus 1.0224077547621127 on ordinals 146..290 in each session. Winner probability correlates less with purchased scores than original means (about 0.178 versus 0.429). In the frozen Search Policy audit, independently reproduced in this ticket's fifteen scratch audits, marginal-preserving diagonalization changes 1638 of 4350 logged first-row winners with all 435 factor hashes verified. That establishes natural dependence exposure, not changed full-10000-row counts or unpurchased outcomes. n-5e03d3ccd1b7 supports retained restricted-Thompson correlation on a different consumer; n-c6895a38b8fd supports retaining fine mean preference under independent restricted residuals. Neither prices the qPO correlation consumer. The bottleneck is conversion of qPO model-internal winner probability into substantial full-session paid progress.

literature_review.conclusion: Reuse the frozen review and its actual recorded queries; the two qPO primary sources were also opened during this plan to inspect provenance. Source experiments use correlated predictive sampling on prefiltered fixed libraries. The campaign already adapts winner counting to fresh de novo fields and an inherited latent jittered posterior. Deliberately removing residual dependence here is an internal conditional contribution control, not faithful adoption of an independent-posterior source algorithm. The full fit, marginals, eligibility and fixed winner-count objective remain, so this test can price allocation correlation on this host. No new source adoptions, assets or dependencies are requested.
literature_review.internal_evidence_reason: The frozen Search Policy review explicitly schedules an isolated existing-consumer control. qPO direct behavior is confirmed but full progress and endpoint gain fail; first-ten-row diagonal replay establishes naturally exposed dependence. The exact all-qPO consumer has not been priced, and the earlier restricted Thompson correlation sign does not transfer without measurement. The intervention adopts no new algorithm element: row-norm decorrelation removes one retained consumer while preserving its fitted marginal law and random-draw expense.

hypothesis: Remove only m-000000000007 cross-candidate residual correlation from every successful allocation of code Parent n-0eae06e8d311. For the unchanged raw mean vector mu, raw score scale s, actual successful Cholesky factor L of the fitted latent pool covariance plus its successful jitter, and the exact existing normal arrays Z, form F_ind[r,i]=mu[i]+s*Z[r,i]*sqrt(sum_j L[i,j]^2). Its conditional mean and actual jittered marginal variance s^2*sum_j L[i,j]^2 equal the Parent law, whereas its population off-diagonal residual covariance is zero. This statement concerns the sampling law; finite sampled off-diagonal empirical covariance need not be zero. Keep the original fitted covariance, Cholesky, means, nonzero marginal uncertainty, eligibility and fixed-domain winner objective. With E sorted by original pool index, count one stable first-maximum winner per row of F_ind over the same E, then choose the announced batch by (-count,-original_mean,pool_index). Passive F_corr=mu+s*(Z@L.T) from those same draws supplies the original qPO count/order comparator only; it cannot change active choices or acquire labels. The working prediction is exposure through changed counts and at least one changed paid set while preserving marginal variance. Score-preserving decorrelation is a separate conditional prediction; loss would support useful retained correlation on this exact host.

finding_summary.headline: Correlation removal executed exactly, but qPO score preservation failed
finding_summary.insights: Residual dependence contributes positively on this exact qPO composition in the observed complete Search panel. That conditional removal result does not establish qPO benefit over the formal Anchor, a transferable dependence effect, or a reliably positive population expectation. The loss is concentrated: docking seed 1 falls 0.703276 while sitagliptin seed 2 gains 0.192177, so a uniform task-level effect is unsupported. The molecular report explains the failed docking path as sustained growth around repeated oversized acid/amide/aromatic structures:230 of 290 purchases exceed 50 heavy atoms, whereas compact connected aryl/amine families elsewhere reach much higher scores. Across the panel, upper-tail purchases rise from 194 to 387 and nonempty typed scaffold variety falls from 1982 to 1780; all 155 sub-twelve-atom purchases carry zero gain. These associations suggest a proposal or search scheme that can escape repeated motif expansion, and a ranking model checked against realized outcomes, rather than assuming more independent winner events improve progress. Per-session selected-stream rank associations remain descriptive and do not reveal unpurchased outcomes. Passive alternatives share Child states only; their continuation was never evaluated. The persistent endpoint goal remains unmet, with its literal Anchor-as-code-Parent condition mismatched and protocol task-safety evidence unavailable. This settles the registered score-preservation prediction under the tested conditions; it leaves other qPO compositions and proposal/ranking interventions open.
finding_summary.results: All 435 allocations used marginal-preserving independent residuals. Independent replay reproduced the accepted-data fit, original random draws, both 10000-row winner-count laws and actual purchases;270 allocations changed their purchased set. Across 4350 paid observations, full incumbent gain fell from 5.24320 to 4.64969 and updates from 300 to 284; late gain fell from 1.33524 to 1.15291 across 2175 purchases. The complete three-seed macro mean was 0.518471, down 0.039568 from the actual qPO Parent and 0.088559 from the formal Anchor. Parent-paired seed differences were−0.013914,−0.144625,+0.039836. This triggers the registered 0.002 loss falsifier for score-preserving decorrelation, while execution and direct activation remain established.

molecular.headline: Aromatic and amine-bearing ring families coexist with fragment collapse, oversized repeated motifs and strained or reactive local chemistry.
molecular.overall_character: Node n-61819156f98f makes connected aromatic and heteroaromatic structures containing amides, imines, amines, ethers, halogens and sulfur groups. Many are ordinary-sized molecular graphs, but local N-halogen/O-halogen bonds, peroxides, strained rings and oversized repeated structures make overall synthetic plausibility questionable. This is a chemical reading, not a synthesis or stability assay. Broad describes aggregate graph diversity; it does not mean every session explores many useful families. The frozen comparison marks Child evaluation complete and code-Parent pairing complete for Search seeds 0/1/2, all five tasks, batch ten and 300 accepted observations per session. All fifteen Child and fifteen published Parent trajectories exist and were read; no tasks are omitted. Each digest task has 900 accepted records including 30 initial and 870 optimizer records. These are accepted paid proposals, not every unpurchased generated graph or rejected attempt. RDKit 2023.09.6 statistics are separate from the digest's deterministic SMILES-presence counters. Across 4350 paid Child/Parent molecules, heavy-atom medians are 29/31; below-twelve counts 155/143 and above-fifty counts 387/194. Nonempty typed/generic Murcko scaffold counts are 1780/1133 versus 1982/1203, with coverage 4218/4350 versus 4226/4350. Largest typed-scaffold fractions among nonempty rows are 0.038170/0.040937; generic fractions are 0.053580/0.103407. Radius-two Morgan sparse-count mean within-batch similarity is 0.493426/0.494712, and nearest preceding-batch archive similarity 0.736831/0.742474. Requiring both query and comparator to have at least twelve heavy atoms gives within-batch 0.524716/0.524489 and nearest-archive 0.760450/0.764520. Late paid ordinals 146-290 contain 2175 purchases, including the last five of announcement fifteen: below-twelve counts are 56/58, above-fifty counts 131/73. Full/late below-twelve incumbent-gain mass is zero for both nodes. Full/late above-fifty Child gains are 0.041688881/0.011732295, versus Parent 0.049963031/0.009860387. Total full gains 4.649686323/5.243198882 telescope to the observed endpoints from initial incumbents; late gains are 1.152907883/1.335237861. These are associations in different adaptive paid streams, not chemical causes of component effects. The trajectories do not show unpurchased scores, generation/admission attrition, breeding parentage, survival, descendant censoring or component/oracle timing; those require Analyze's separate logs. Formal Anchor n-cf8d309c06de is distinct from code Parent n-0eae06e8d311; the chemistry comparison here is to the latter, with no new direct Anchor chemistry comparison. No uniquely missing pharmacophore can be inferred from these traces. method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
